Chandler (People Ops): Thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A earlier. If you have follow-ups about performance reviews / leveling / promos / comp buckets, drop them here and we’ll respond. I’ll compile a short FAQ by EOD tomorrow. Slides: https://redwood.example.com/allhands/jun-2026

Lina (SWE): quick q — if my promotion clears during calibration, when does the salary bump actually start? same pay cycle or next?

Chandler (People Ops): Good q. Target effective date is the 1st of the month after comp adjustments are applied (we aim for 7/1 for the mid-year cycle). If approval happens after payroll cut-offs it might roll into the following cycle. We’ll publish exact cut-off dates in the promo packet.

Marco (PM): Are we changing leveling rubrics? I heard "manager expectations" were updated — will that block anyone currently nominated?

Emma (People Ops): We updated the IC leveling language to make ownership/scale clearer for IC3+. Changes are clarifying and additive; they won’t retroactively penalize active nominations. Managers should reference the new rubric when writing their recommendation.

Sara (VP Eng): For calibration, managers should include 3 concise signals: 1) project impact (metrics if available), 2) peer/partner feedback, 3) demonstrated ownership/stretch. One-line examples are super helpful in the packet. We’ll pilot a dry-run with one eng team next week to align.

Marco (PM): If a promo is denied in this cycle, is there a standard re-nom window?

Chandler (People Ops): Usually 6 months before re-nom unless the denial is performance-based. If it’s a close call, managers can file an expedited re-review with the calibration chair and People Ops will advise.

Lina (SWE): For comp bands — any company-wide market adjustments coming or is it targeted?

Emma (People Ops): Market refresh is targeted this round. We prioritize folks who are 10%+ below market median. Others will be evaluated; we’ll share anonymized band percentiles and a FAQ doc after we finalize the budget.

Ryan (CEO): Quick note — promotions matter for both recognition and long-term retention. We prefer to act decisively on clear impact, but we also want consistency across teams. Managers: flag edge cases to People Ops early.

hr-bot: Promo packet template: /docs/promo-packet-v2.md 

Chandler (People Ops): Also — small operational thing: managers please attach a one-line impact blurb and list of reviewers in the packet to speed calibration. Thanks everyone — compiling answers and timelines now, expect the follow-up doc and cut-off dates by tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
